items.description: node-semver version or range specification without source specifiers (e.g. '0.0.0', '^1.0.0', '*')

version.description: Schema versions to run against, specified as node-semver version or range strings without source specifiers. If omitted, defaults to the highest patch version of each major.minor.

profiles.description: Profiles to evaluate. Default: all four.

formatsMode.description: ajv-formats mode for the assertion profile.

exactErrors.description: Require the actual error count to equal expectedErrors.length.

requireExpectedErrors.description: Behavior when an invalid example has no matching expectedErrors.

checkWrappers.description: Also validate every examples file against its wrapper schema.

refMap.description: Map remote $ref / $schema URLs to local files relative to root.

offline.description: Never use the network for remote $refs.

file.description: Substring of the examples file path.

label.description: Exact label (or name) of the example.
